# pve_storage_oci_pull (Action)

Pulls an OCI image from a registry into a storage (`POST /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/oci-registry-pull`) and waits for the pull task to finish. Requires the `Datastore.AllocateTemplate` privilege on `/storage/{storage}` and `Sys.AccessNetwork` on `/nodes/{node}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Pull the Alpine 3.20 OCI image from Docker Hub into the local storage of
# node pve1 and wait for the pull to finish.
action "pve_storage_oci_pull" "pull_alpine" {
  config {
    node      = "pve1"
    storage   = "local"
    reference = "docker.io/library/alpine:3.20"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node pulling the image; the task runs here.
- `reference` (String) Reference to the OCI image to download, e.g. `docker.io/library/alpine:3.20`.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier to pull the image into.

### Optional

- `filename` (String) Custom destination file name of the OCI image; upstream normalizes it. Omit to let PVE derive the name from the reference.
